investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC via curl (plain HTTP GET, descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser): retained the homepage, the /en/programme calendar list page, and 3 individual event detail pages linked directly from that list. The homepage and programme page each carry exactly one application/ld+json block (BreadcrumbList only -- no Event/MusicEvent schema); event detail pages carry only itemtype="http://schema.org/Article" microdata (itemprop="headline" on the title only). No ICS/RSS/Atom link, no wp-json, no Fourvenues script, no Sanity config were present anywhere. The actual event facts (date/time/location/category) are exposed as plain, consistently-classed server-rendered HTML on each event's own detail page (e.g. <span class="event-detail-date-begin">), which is sufficient to answer the investigation question at Level 1 -- no escalation was needed.

probe_history.reason: The venue's own official programme calendar (https://www.silent-green.net/en/programme, TYPO3 CMS with the 'news' extension per meta generator + tx_news_pi1 query params) links to per-event detail pages at a stable URL pattern (/en/programme/detail/{slug}). Three sampled detail pages (htrk, hanno-leichtmann-oscillazioni, silent-green-open-lab-9-jkzq-franna) each server-render the full event facts in consistently-named CSS-classed spans: event-detail-date-begin/-end, event-detail-time-begin/-end, event-detail-location, event-detail-category, plus <h1 itemprop="headline"> for the title and a rel="canonical" link for the stable event URL. No JSON-LD Event/MusicEvent schema, ICS link, RSS/Atom feed, WordPress/Tribe signature, Fourvenues script, or Sanity config exists on this domain -- but the plain server-rendered HTML itself directly and unambiguously answers every required field, so this genuinely terminates the escalation ladder at Level 1.

venue_reference: silent green Kulturquartier (cultural venue with a substantial experimental/electronic music programme, former crematorium, Gerichtstraße 35, Wedding, Berlin)

identity.notes: The homepage's own title ('silent green Kulturquartier') and every retained event detail page's own footer contact block ('Contact silent green / Gerichtstraße 35 13347 Berlin / T: +49 (0)30 1208221-0 / info(at)silent-green.net') directly confirm official identity and match the venue's well-known Wedding address (the former crematorium building).

site_classification.platform: TYPO3 CMS (meta generator: 'TYPO3 CMS') with the 'news' extension (tx_news) powering /en/programme -- a server-rendered calendar-grid list page (by month, e.g. /en/programme/2026/8) linking to per-event detail pages at /en/programme/detail/{slug}. No public JSON/REST API, RSS/ICS feed, or JSON-LD Event schema was found; all event facts are exposed as plain, consistently-classed HTML.

title.notes: Each event detail page's own <h1 itemprop="headline">; value shown is from the primary sampled record (htrk). Confirmed consistent in structure across all 3 sampled pages.

start_date.notes: Each event detail page's own <span class="event-detail-date-begin"> states a complete, self-contained date including weekday, month, day and year, e.g. 'Sun 08/02/2026', independently corroborated on the same page by the spelled-out 'Sunday, August 2' in the body text -- confirmed consistent across all 3 sampled pages, no combination with other page context needed. Value shown (2026-08-02, ISO) is from the primary sampled record (htrk).

time.notes: Each event detail page's own <span class="event-detail-time-begin"> ('Start') and <span class="event-detail-time-entry"> ('Doors'), a local 12-hour time with am/pm. No UTC offset/timezone is stated on the page (Berlin local time is implied, not proven) -- FLOATING_LOCAL, not upgraded to UTC. Value shown is from the primary sampled record (htrk).

end.notes: Present only for some records: multi-day installations/exhibitions (e.g. hanno-leichtmann-oscillazioni) carry an explicit <span class="event-detail-date-end">/<span class="event-detail-time-end">; single-evening concerts (e.g. htrk) render neither span at all. This is honest per-record variability in what the source itself exposes, not a parsing gap -- a future collector must record NOT_PRESENT per-record when these spans are absent, never infer an end time.

venue_location.notes: Each event detail page's own <span class="event-detail-location"> -- one of silent green's own named rooms within its single Gerichtstraße 35 building (consistent with this project's existing room-is-not-a-separate-venue precedent, e.g. Casa da Música/Jamboree). Value shown is from the primary sampled record (htrk); all 3 sampled records were also 'Kuppelhalle'.

source_record_id.notes: No numeric id is exposed on the rendered page; each event's own canonical URL slug (e.g. 'htrk', 'hanno-leichtmann-oscillazioni') is the site's own stable, documented permalink (rel="canonical" on the very same page) -- the same documented judgement already established for Moog Barcelona / LAV in this repository (URL-slug-as-source_record_id). Value shown is the primary sampled record's slug.

event_url.notes: Each event detail page's own <link rel="canonical">. Value shown is from the primary sampled record (htrk).

price.notes: No price is rendered on any sampled detail page. The 'Ticket' button, when present, links out to a third-party ticketing platform (e.g. https://ra.co/events/2478204 for htrk) without price shown on this domain; for the other 2 samples no ticket link is present at all (free-entry exhibitions/installations, not stated explicitly as such).

blockers.description: The programme calendar list page only exposes day-of-month + title + category per event (full date/time/location require visiting each event's own detail page); a collector needs a two-step discover-then-fetch-detail pattern, matching this repository's existing discovery.mjs + observation-adapter.mjs convention (e.g. ingestion/hot-clube/).

reasons: Identity PROVEN directly from the venue's own retained pages.
acquisition_class STATIC_HTML, a resolved, supported class, reached entirely at Level 1.
A CONFIRMED public data path retained for both the discovery list page and the event detail page template, with 3 real sampled events.
title, start_date, time, venue_location, source_record_id, and event_url all PROVEN with basis DIRECT_SOURCE.
end honestly assessed PARTIAL (present only for multi-day records) and price honestly NOT_PRESENT -- no fields fabricated.
recommended_family STATIC_EVENT_LIST, an existing, known collector family requiring no new code family.

No offline, dependency-free, no-network parser reproduction has been built or run against the retained fixtures in this investigation task -- per this task's own scope, only the investigation record was produced, not collector/test code -- so gate 9 (a DETERMINISTIC_DERIVATION evidence item) is not yet satisfied and READY_FOR_ACTIVATION is not claimed. This investigation is complete and ready for that separate offline-proof/collector-build follow-up step.
